subject:
Pilot credits 


 burn rate & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits - burn rate & pricing follow-up

Hi Alex / Samir -

Great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Usage so far (pilot week 1): ~18M tokens total (24% chat, 76% completion calls). See attached pilot-usage-aug.csv for session-level breakdown.
- Expected pilot duration: 4 weeks (current plan) with potential expansion to a production contract in Q4 if perf & economics look good.
- Customer priority: keep inference costs <= $50 / 1M tokens (target unit economics) to make the ROI work against current label/annotation budgets.
- Current target monthly budget range: $20k - $50k (they want a predictable per-month cap during ramp).

Action items:
1) Alex to confirm average prompt+response token ratio for the cohort (you said ~1.6:1 on today's call).
2) Marissa to propose a short credits extension to cover remaining pilot weeks and a burn-rate checkpoint mid-extension.
3) If extension approved, internal approvals needed (credits owner + finance).

Proposed credits ask (tentative): $10k in credits (~200M tokens at $50/1M) to cover the remainder of the pilot and some headroom for stress tests. If you'd prefer token-based credits instead of dollar credits, we can issue 200,000,000 tokens.

Next call? If you can confirm burn-rate estimate and preferred credit form (dollars vs tokens), I'll schedule a 20-min check-in for Friday.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pilot-usage-aug.csv

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits - burn rate & pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa - quick answers below.

- Confirmed avg token ratio: ~1.6:1 (prompt:response). That aligns with our traffic.
- Current weekly burn: ~18M tokens (this includes NLU pre-processing calls + augmentation). Expect this to double when we add the second cohort in week 3.
- Preferred credit form: dollar credits are easiest for procurement, but token credits are fine if you have a standard mapping.
- Budget: We can commit to $20k/mo initially, but to go to full production we'll need to see effective unit economics closer to $35 - $45 / 1M tokens.

We're good with the $10k pilot credit extension as a start - can you send the internal approval note and any required PoV terms? Also please set the mid-extension checkpoint (week 2 after extension starts) so we can evaluate burn and quality.

Alex
Head of ML Products | Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits - burn rate & pricing follow-up

Vivek - forwarding the thread and the attached usage CSV. Quick ask: can we approve a $10k pilot credit (or token equivalent) to Acme Health to cover the next 2-3 weeks?

Context / justification:
- Pilot shows steady usage (~18M tokens/week) with expected spike to ~36M tokens/week when second cohort is added.
- Acme has indicated purchase intent if unit economics fall in the $35-45 / 1M tokens range; extending credits gives us the runway to validate that with realistic volumes.
- Risk: worst-case they burn credits quickly but do not convert - we've historically seen ~35% conversion from pilots with this profile after technical success + cost fit.

Requested approval fields (simple):
- Credits amount: $10,000 (or token equivalent ~200M at $50/1M)
- Validity window: 30 days from issue
- Reporting: mid-extension checkpoint call (schedule 2 weeks after issuance) and shared usage CSV

If you approve, I'll generate the internal credit memo and attach a credits-approval.pdf for procurement.

Thanks - marking this time-sensitive; they're expecting confirmation today so we don't stall the cohort launch.

- Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits - burn rate & pricing follow-up

Marissa - approved.

Approval details:
- Credits: $10,000 USD in account credits
- Token equivalence: 200,000,000 tokens (for tracking only)
- Validity: 30 days from issuance
- Reporting requirement: mid-extension checkpoint call scheduled for Thu, Aug 20, 2026 to review burn and quality metrics; Marissa to set calendar invite.
- Finance note: Paste credits-approval.pdf into the internal credit request ticket and cc finance@redwood.com.

Marissa - please issue credits and share the credits-approval.pdf with Alex / Samir. Close the internal ticket after finance confirmation.

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
